latin_incipit: Impossibile est eandem speciem generari tam per propagationem quam per putrefactionem.
english_translation: It is impossible for the same species to be generated both through propagation and putrefaction.
charge: Averroes defends the determinate character of species generation, opposing spontaneous generation.
defense: Pico agrees, using this to support a teleological biology in which form and essence constrain material processes.
exegesis: Averroes held that species have determinate modes of generation. Pico agrees: a rational animal cannot arise both through normal procreation and decay (spontaneous generation). This defends a more teleological biology.

scholar_citations.work: Syncretism in the West: Pico's Platform

notes: Supports Pico's defense of formal causation and real essences against naturalistic reductionism.
